## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The approval comparison in `zzz-release/gate.py` must be fixed before merge: it now blocks releases that have exactly the minimum number of approvals.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, which renames 1,500 `legacy-service-NNNN` entries to `production-service-NNNN`, moves their ports from 10000–11499 to 20000–21499 and adds a top-level `review_note` string. It also changes `healthy()` in `services/registry.py` to `not failures` and changes `approved()` in `zzz-release/gate.py` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` so the exact minimum approves a release — `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False` because the comparison changed from `approvals >= minimum` to `approvals > minimum`. The module docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." `tests/test_release.py:11-16` checks only 3 and 1 approvals, so no test covers this boundary. — Any release with exactly the required number of approvals is blocked, so every release now needs one approval more than the configured minimum. — Fix: Revert to `approvals >= minimum` and add an `approved(2, minimum=2)` case next to `test_approved_release`.

## Important
(none)

(none)

## Not reviewed
- The `aaa-generated/catalog.json` hunk was not read line by line between pinned-diff lines 2234 and 8984; a pattern count across the whole diff showed that all 3,000 added rename and port lines match the `production-service-NNNN` / `2NNNN` form.
- The generator and the downstream consumers of `aaa-generated/catalog.json` are not in this repository, so this review could not check whether the new port range and the added non-service `review_note` key work with them.
